finding.summary: New `DateCell` component (preference-driven text + `title` tooltip) has no test at all
finding.evidence: `DateCell` is the whole point of the feature in the list: it calls `useDateFormat()`, renders `formatListDate(value, format)` and sets `title={formatFullDateTime(value)}` (document-list.tsx:240-247). The added tests only cover the pure helpers (tests/app/documents/document-list-utils.test.ts) and the store (tests/lib/date-format-preference.test.ts). Nothing renders `DateCell` or `dateColumn`'s cell, so the acceptance criterion "both columns carry a `title` tooltip with the full localized date+time in every format" is unverified — swapping the two formatters, dropping `title=`, or passing the wrong value would leave the suite green. The frontend also has no `tsc` lane, so a wrong prop wouldn't be caught elsewhere either. Searched: tests/app/documents/ contains only document-list-utils.test.ts and tab-name.test.ts; grep for `DateCell`/`document-list` across packages/frontend returns no test file.

verdict.reason: The finding asserts DateCell has "no test at all", but packages/frontend/tests/app/documents/date-cell.test.tsx exists and renders the real component. It imports DateCell from @/app/documents/document-list (line 4) and the real helpers/store (lines 5-9, nothing mocked), then asserts: relative text by default (line 40), exact-format text when the preference is set, with an explicit not.toMatch(/ago$/) (lines 51-52), the tooltip criterion title === formatFullDateTime(value) plus independent /2026/ and /\d{1,2}:\d{2}/ shape checks (lines 59-61), live re-render on setDateFormat("exact") without remount (lines 64-76), and the em-dash fallback on both text and title for undefined and unparseable values (lines 78-87). These are non-vacuous: the exact mutations the reviewer names would fail — dropping title= breaks line 59, swapping formatListDate/formatFullDateTime breaks lines 40 and 59, and a wrong value breaks line 60. The component matches the described wiring (document-list.tsx:240-247, exported; dateColumn cell at :269). The test is in the CI lane: vite.config.ts:268 includes "tests/**/*.test.tsx" with jsdom environment (:267). The reviewer's stated file inventory of tests/app/documents/ is simply incorrect.
